faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: What is the best weapon in {game}?
By max-level damage, {blade} is the best blade and {edge} the best Phantom Edge. This ranking ignores speed and playstyle.
Which build should I use early game?
{w1}, {w2}, {w3} and {w4} are all found in the first areas and make a solid loadout.
How many weapons are there in {game}?
The planner lists {nb} blades and {ne} Phantom Edges, {n} weapons in total.
Where do the numbers come from?
They are cross-checked between several public sources. {ok} of {n} weapons are confirmed by at least two sources, the others are flagged on their page.
